1-a.reviewMethod: Canonical-segment-aligned clause-by-clause translation and independent review; legacy English used only as a witness.
1-a.reviewerNotes: All 14 canonical segments were independently reviewed against the exact canonical Hebrew and mapped legacy chapter 1. Repetitions, false starts, bracketed turns, uncertainty markers, and source paragraph boundaries were preserved; witness-only additions were excluded. Segment-level source hashes and review findings are recorded in each segment's qa metadata.
